definitions.gloss: energizing; passing an electric current through something
definitions.explanation: Applying electric current to a device or circuit so that it becomes live, typically to power equipment on for operation or testing. Takes する to form a verb.

examples.japanese: {装置|そうち}に{通電|つうでん}する。
{通電|つうでん}すると、ランプが{点灯|てんとう}する。
examples.english: When you apply current, the lamp lights up.

examples.japanese: {配線|はいせん}を{確認|かくにん}してから{通電|つうでん}してください。
examples.english: Please check the wiring before turning on the power.

notes:
Refers to letting electricity flow into a circuit or appliance, typically to power it up or test it. Takes する to become a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通電|つうでん}{確認|かくにん}: checking that current flows
- {通電|つうでん}{状態|じょうたい}: a powered, live state
- {通電|つうでん}{試験|しけん}: an energization test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {導電|どうでん}: electrical conduction — the property of conducting, not the act of switching on
- {停電|ていでん}: power outage — a loss of electricity supply
